slots.name: tiger weight
slots.sentence: Mike the Tiger VII may be one of Louisiana State University’s most recognizable symbols, but the 400-pound tiger is not treated like a pet or game day prop.

slots.name: outdoor habitat size
slots.sentence: Mike’s home includes a roughly 14,000-square-foot outdoor yard with a stream, waterfall, two pools and a large rock that stays warm in winter and cool in summer, along with about 1,000 square feet of indoor space.

slots.name: caretaker proximity
slots.sentence: One caretaker must remain within 20 minutes of Baton Rouge at all times.

slots.name: indoor habitat size
slots.sentence: along with about 1,000 square feet of indoor space.

slots.name: veterinary students
slots.sentence: Mike’s daily care is overseen by a faculty veterinarian and two veterinary students, who serve two-year appointments and work as a team seven days a week.
